description: Experience-gifting company founded in 2014 and headquartered in Vilnius, Lithuania, selling gift boxes and vouchers redeemable for experiences (adventures, spa days, food tours, getaways) in more than 100 countries.

evidence.summary: Tinggly's official affiliate page states the program runs on Impact Radius (ID 23213) with tiered commission: 1-3 sales/month pays 5%, 4-11 sales/month pays 10%, and 12+ sales/month pays 15%. Signup is instant and free, no website is required (social channels including YouTube, Instagram and TikTok are accepted), and the page states 'More than 400 people have joined our affiliate network.' No earnings-cap statement appears on the page, so the cap is recorded as unknown; 400+ joined is a few hundred, so saturation is unknown rather than low.

EU-Startups' directory profile states Tinggly was founded in 2014 by Linas Ceikus and Alex Gibb and is headquartered in Vilnius, Lithuania, as a global experience gifting company within the Tinggly Group of European experience gift companies.

name: Tinggly

reasons.compensation: Published tiered commission on the brand's own page reaching 15% at 12+ sales/month — solid, transparent pay for the travel niche.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated affiliate page with instant Impact signup and a named program route; the page's contact email was masked in the fetched copy, so no email is recorded.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2014, headquartered in Vilnius, part of a European experience-gift group with 300+ employees per EU-Startups.
reasons.niche_fit: Experience gifts are highly demonstrable in travel and gifting content, and the brand explicitly welcomes social-first promoters.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open, instant, free signup on Impact with no website requirement.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The official page confirms an active affiliate network of 400+ promoters and names YouTube, Instagram and TikTok as accepted promotion channels, though no formal UGC/ambassador program is published.

description: Amsterdam-based travel platform (Tripaneer B.V.) for themed holidays — yoga and meditation retreats, surf camps, wellness, martial arts and culinary trips worldwide, with trip prices roughly from $100 to $10,000.

evidence.summary: Tripaneer's official help page documents its in-house affiliate commission share: affiliates receive a share of the commission Tripaneer itself earns on a booking — 35% of that commission at 0-50 bookings/month, 40% at 51-100, 45% at 101-250 and 50% at 250+. Tripaneer states it receives 10-20% commission on bookings on average, and inquiries carry a 14-day cookie. The recorded 35 is the entry-tier share of Tripaneer's commission, not a percentage of the booking price. No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is unknown.
Tripaneer's affiliate agreement (referenced from its BookYogaRetreats affiliate page) provides monthly payout by bank transfer or PayPal with a €100 minimum payout threshold.

name: Tripaneer

opportunity.title: Tripaneer Affiliate Program — 35-50% share of booking commission

reasons.compensation: Published revenue-share tiers (35% rising to 50% of Tripaneer's 10-20% booking commission, i.e. roughly 3.5-10% of booking value) — transparent terms, mid-range effective rate.
reasons.contact_access: A public affiliate signup route exists via its retreat brands' affiliate pages, with terms documented in the official help center.
reasons.credibility: Established Amsterdam-based platform (Tripaneer B.V.) operating multiple themed-travel brands.
reasons.niche_fit: Retreats, surf camps and wellness trips are strong travel-creator content categories with high order values.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open affiliate application; no follower threshold published.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A documented in-house affiliate program exists, but no published ambassador/UGC program or creator community was found.

description: UK online travel agent describing itself as the UK's fastest-growing travel agent and Ireland's top online travel agent, selling package holidays, flights and hotels across UK, Irish, German and Austrian markets; it states it has sent over 7 million people on holiday.

evidence.summary: loveholidays' official affiliate page states the programme is managed on Partnerize, pays commission only on consumed bookings (paid within 60 days of the departure date, last-click attribution), and is open to all publishers except adult content sites. The page publishes no commission rate and no earnings-cap statement, so the cap is unknown.
Travelpayouts' partner-program guide reports loveholidays pays 4% commission of the order cost on consumed bookings, with payout within 90 days after checkout at the time of writing.

Shopper's partnership listing reports a higher payout of up to 6% per sale, which conflicts with the 4% reported by Travelpayouts and Creator Hero; the 4% figure is recorded as the corroborated rate and the 6% figure is flagged here.

name: loveholidays

reasons.compensation: 4% of order cost on consumed bookings is corroborated by two independent sources; a 6% outlier is flagged in evidence.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated official affiliate page with clear joining instructions via Partnerize signup.
reasons.credibility: One of the UK's largest online travel agents, rated 4.4/5 from 288,169 Trustpilot reviews per its own page.
reasons.niche_fit: Package holidays and deals are staple travel-creator content, with high booking values offsetting a modest percentage.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to all publishers (except adult sites) through Partnerize registration.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An open publisher programme with a committed affiliate team per the official page, but no creator/ambassador program is published.

description: Online travel agency of Spain's eDreams ODIGEO group, selling flights, hotels, flight+hotel packages and car hire, and built around its Prime travel subscription programme.

evidence.summary: eDreams' official Awin merchant profile (eDreams US) publishes a product-based commission schedule instead of a single rate: Flights 2%, Flights+Prime 3%, Flight+hotel 2%, Flight+hotel+Prime 3%, Hotel 2%, Hotel+Prime 6% and Car hire 6%, on a 30-day cookie. Because no single rate applies, commission_rate is null and the schedule is documented here. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.

name: eDreams

reasons.compensation: Published Awin schedule of 2-6% depending on product — real but low, and no single headline rate exists.
reasons.contact_access: Joinable through the official Awin merchant profile; no direct creator contact is published.
reasons.credibility: eDreams ODIGEO is one of the world's largest online travel groups and a publicly listed Spanish company.
reasons.niche_fit: Flights and hotels are core travel content, though a large OTA is a less distinctive creator partner than a niche brand.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A standard network affiliate program only; no creator or ambassador program is published.

description: New York-founded travel goods brand launched in 2017 by husband-and-wife team Kish and Vanessa Jeswani, known for the Bento Bag and thoughtfully designed travel bags and accessories for modern business travelers; its Bento Bag crowdfunding raised over $2M.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory (last updated March 11, 2024) lists Nomad Lane's affiliate program on ShareASale paying a flat $5 per sale (not a percentage) with a 15-day cookie, open to all regions. The flat bounty is documented here and commission_rate is null. No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is unknown.

LeadIQ's company profile describes Nomad Lane as a New York-based retailer founded in 2017 by Kish and Vanessa Jeswani, designing travel bags and accessories, with the Bento Bag raising over $2M in crowdfunding pre-orders and coverage in Forbes and Travel + Leisure.

name: Nomad Lane

opportunity.title: Nomad Lane Affiliate Program (ShareASale) — flat $5 per sale

reasons.compensation: A flat $5 per sale on premium-priced bags is low versus percentage programs, and the listing dates from March 2024.
reasons.contact_access: No affiliate page or contact is published on the brand's own site; the only route is the ShareASale listing in the directory.
reasons.credibility: Small independent brand (2-10 employees per LeadIQ) with strong crowdfunding history and national press coverage.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium travel bags are a natural fit for packing and travel-gear content, though the catalog is narrow.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Joinable via ShareASale per the directory listing, but not promoted on the brand's own site.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Only a network affiliate listing was found; no creator program, ambassador page or UGC evidence is published.

description: Texas-rooted footwear brand founded in 2007 making designer-quality, handcrafted leather western boots for women (and men), bench-made by artisans in its own factory in León, Mexico since 2013, with its signature turquoise soles; average listed product price is about $311.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory (last updated March 11, 2024) lists the Lane Boots affiliate program on ShareASale at 18% per sale with a 15-day cookie, open to all regions.

Snow Consulting, the agency that manages the program, announced the Lane Boots affiliate program on ShareASale and invites affiliates to join — corroborating the network and that the program is actively managed.

Lasso's 'Lane Boots Preferred' listing reports a 6%-18% per sale range with a 15-day cookie, and Shopper reports 5-10%, while an older Mopubi listing reported 15%. Because the reported rates conflict, commission_rate is null and the range is documented here. No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is unknown.

Boot Collector's brand profile states Lane Boots launched in 2007 with Texas roots, makes its boots in León, Mexico, and has run its own dedicated factory there since late 2013, expanding from boots into booties, mules, loafers, accessories and apparel.

name: Lane Boots

reasons.compensation: Published rates are strong at the top end (18% per LinkClicky; Lasso reports a 6-18% range) but conflict across sources, so no single rate is recorded.
reasons.contact_access: No affiliate page or creator contact is published on the brand's own site; joining runs through ShareASale.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2007, operates its own factory, estimated $10-25M annual revenue per LeadIQ — an established independent brand.
reasons.niche_fit: Designer western boots are a distinctive, demonstrable fashion niche with premium prices (about $311 average) that suit outfit and styling content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via ShareASale per the directory and the program's managing agency.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An actively managed ShareASale program plus an influencer-program listing exist, but no ambassador or UGC program is published on the brand's own site.

description: UK women's footwear brand selling trend-led heels, boots, sandals and shoes (plus clothing) through its own website, aimed at fast-fashion shoppers.

evidence.summary: Public Desire's official Awin merchant profile states a default commission of 8% on all sales with up to 15% commission available, a 30-day cookie, commission calculated excluding VAT and P&P, and commissions validated over 30 days; the program is managed by Conversion Digital. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.
Uppromote's shoe affiliate program comparison independently lists Public Desire at 8% commission with a 30-day cookie for trendy women's shoes, corroborating the Awin profile's default rate.

name: Public Desire

opportunity.title: Public Desire Affiliate Program (Awin) — 8% default, up to 15%

reasons.compensation: Published 8% default rate (up to 15%) on the official Awin profile, corroborated by an independent directory — solid for fast-fashion footwear.
reasons.contact_access: Joinable via the official Awin merchant profile; no direct creator email is published.
reasons.credibility: Established UK fast-fashion footwear brand with an agency-managed affiliate program.
reasons.niche_fit: Trend-led women's footwear is a staple of fashion haul and outfit content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An active, agency-managed network program exists; no separate ambassador/UGC program was found on the brand's own pages.

description: US specialty retailer of youth apparel, footwear and accessories rooted in Southern California surf, skate and street culture, selling through tillys.com and stores nationwide.

evidence.summary: Tillys' official affiliate page states its affiliate program runs on Impact, offers a 'competitive commission up to 15%', cross-device tracking and a product feed of 70,000+ products, for Tillys.com only. The page states no base rate and no earnings cap, so the cap is unknown.

Third-party directories conflict with the brand's 'up to 15%' ceiling: AffJumbo reports 4%, affiliate-watch reports 5% with a 14-day cookie, and FMTC reports up to 5-15%. Because the actual base rate cannot be pinned to one figure, commission_rate is null and the conflict is documented here.

name: Tillys

reasons.compensation: The brand publishes only an 'up to 15%' ceiling and directories report 4-5%, so compensation is real but scored mid-range pending a verifiable base rate.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated affiliate page on the official site with the Impact joining route.
reasons.credibility: Long-established US specialty retailer with nationwide stores and a public-company parent.
reasons.niche_fit: Youth surf/skate/street apparel maps well to Gen Z fashion creators on TikTok and Instagram.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A documented network affiliate program with a large product feed; no separate ambassador program was found.

description: UK women's fashion brand selling trend-led footwear (heels, boots, sandals) and clothing online, with affiliate programs covering the UK and a dedicated US & Canada program.

evidence.summary: EGO's official Awin merchant profile (US & Canada program) is internally inconsistent: its steps text states affiliates earn 5% per sale for new customers and 3% for existing customers, while the same profile also states 'Earn 7% Commission per sale.' Lasso separately reports a 0.8%-5.6% range with a 30-day cookie. Because the sources conflict, commission_rate is null and the conflict is documented here. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.

name: EGO

reasons.compensation: Rates are published but self-contradictory on the official Awin profile (3%/5% vs 7%), so no rate is recorded and compensation scores low.
reasons.contact_access: Joinable via the official Awin merchant profile; no direct creator contact published.
reasons.credibility: Established UK online fashion retailer with international shipping and network-managed programs.
reasons.niche_fit: Trend-led heels and going-out fashion fit fashion UGC well, especially in the UK and North America.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Awin for the US & Canada program.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An active Awin program exists; no ambassador or UGC program was found on the brand's own pages.

description: Global teen lifestyle brand owned by Abercrombie & Fitch Co., launched in 2000 with a laid-back Southern California aesthetic across apparel, fragrance and loungewear.

evidence.summary: Hollister's official Community page introduces the Hollister Style Hub, its community of content creators: members receive gifted products, unlock levels by completing challenges, earn commission, and can be featured in campaigns. Eligibility as published: loves Hollister, creates content, has more than 1,500 followers on TikTok or Instagram, and is 16 or older.

The official Hollister Style Hub terms describe a level-based creator community hosted on the Duel platform where higher levels bring gifted product and higher commission rates, plus a Hollister Storefront program for earning commission on curated UGC; applicants must be invited and accepted to participate.
Uppromote's affiliate directory reports Hollister's network affiliate program runs primarily through Impact with a 10-day cookie and commission of 3-5% per sale, varying by performance and region.

Shopper's partnership listing reports a Hollister payout of 5-10% per sale, which conflicts with the 3-5% range reported by Uppromote, and neither the Style Hub pages nor the terms publish a rate. commission_rate is therefore null with the conflict documented. No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is unknown.

name: Hollister

opportunity.title: Hollister Style Hub — Community of Content Creators

reasons.compensation: Commission is confirmed by the brand's own pages and terms, but no rate is published and directories conflict (3-5% vs 5-10%), so no rate is recorded and compensation scores conservatively.
reasons.contact_access: A public creator community page on the official site spells out eligibility and benefits.
reasons.credibility: A flagship brand of Abercrombie & Fitch Co., a major publicly traded US retailer.
reasons.niche_fit: Teen/Gen Z apparel from a major youth brand — a core fashion UGC category with a clear TikTok/Instagram audience.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to creators with 1,500+ TikTok/Instagram followers, but the terms state applicants must be invited and accepted, so availability is not fully open.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal, level-based creator community (Style Hub) with gifting, challenges, commission and campaign features, plus a UGC Storefront program — strong, current creator infrastructure.
